description_en: Queries the list of recoverable database backups
description_zh: 查询可恢复数据库备份列表
name: DescribeUniRecoverableList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy for the database.
You can call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of recoverable database backup snapshots on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的可恢复数据库备份快照的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The current page number when using paging
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of recoverable database backup snapshots per page when using paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的可恢复数据库备份快照的数量

RecoverableInfoList.description_en: The list of recoverable database backup snapshots
RecoverableInfoList.description_zh: 可恢复数据库备份快照列表

items.description_en: The information about a recoverable database backup snapshot
items.description_zh: 可恢复数据库备份快照信息

FirstTime.description_en: The timestamp when the backup started. Unit: milliseconds
FirstTime.description_zh: 开始备份的时间戳，单位：毫秒

LastTime.description_en: The timestamp of the latest backup. Unit: milliseconds
LastTime.description_zh: 最新备份的时间戳，单位：毫秒

ResetScn.description_en: The reset_scn value of the selected record in the recoverable point-in-time query for an Oracle database backup
ResetScn.description_zh: 针对Oracle数据库查询备份时，对应查询可恢复的时间点中所选择记录的reset_scn值

ResetTime.description_en: The reset_time value of the selected record in the recoverable point-in-time query for an Oracle database backup
ResetTime.description_zh: 针对Oracle数据库查询备份时，对应查询可恢复的时间点中所选择记录的reset_time值

RestoreInfo.description_en:
The database restoration information when the database type is MSSQL. The value is a JSON string. Valid values:
name: the database name.
files: the database file path
RestoreInfo.description_zh:
恢复数据库类型为MSSQL时，数据库恢复信息。格式为JSON字符串格式，取值：
name：数据库名称
files：数据库文件路径

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of recoverable database backup snapshots
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的可恢复数据库备份快照的总数量
